findings.reason: as written the done-when can be satisfied by a test that never exercises the pipe, so the gate would pass on a node whose stream wake is not wired.
findings.text: the simulation "a served process whose inotify watch is replaced by one that never fires" names one watch, but two exist per tree: the fleet watch's `_ProjectChangeWatch` armed in `_FleetChangeWatch._arm_every_tree` (serve.py:265-272) and each stream's own `_ProjectChangeWatch(docs_dir)` at serve.py:2782. A test that replaces only the fleet watch still has the stream's own inotify descriptor live, so a locally written document wakes that stream directly and the assertion "an open stream receives a `change` event through its subscription pipe" passes with the subscription pipe broken — the very mechanism the node exists to add would be untested
